description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Kalubowila, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, identity card numbers, and encumbrances. The content is focused entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements for specific land parcels in designated locations.
